## Summary

A clear and concise summary of the proposed feature or improvement.

## Motivation & Academic Justification

Explain the problem this feature solves and any reference to academic literature (e.g., GEO benchmark protocols, attribution modeling, multilingual NLP benchmarks).

## Proposed Implementation

Describe your proposed solution or architectural changes:
1. Backend changes (crawling, extraction, AI simulation, scoring, generation)
2. Frontend changes (components, visualizations, exports)
3. API contracts or database schema modifications

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or designs you considered.
